Interpretation limits

  • 325 is a campaign-level count, not an independent additional set of 325 multimodal executions.
  • Published anomaly labels are not validated operation-level event annotations.
  • Repeated measurements within one cycle are not independent observations. The two campaigns share one testbed.
  • Raw source file hashes, exact bytes, current downloadable versions, complete class counts, and source-level temporal alignment have not been audited in this planning repository.
  • Do not convert a cycle-level component-omission label into a claim that a particular operation was skipped or failed.

Proposed enhancement — not implemented

Source-linked process-stage annotations and anomaly-to-evidence associations. This is a research objective, not an existing feature of this repository. Research roadmap.

Licensing and verification

The paper reports CC BY-SA 4.0 in its License section (PDF p. 6, License). This records the publication's statement, not an independent per-file license audit. See licensing boundaries. Original creators retain credit; acquisition took place at the University of South Carolina.

Checked 2026-10-24: paper metadata and the published URL list; expected landing-page titles observed. Not checked: authenticated downloads, file integrity, class frequencies, consent documentation, or completed manufacturing validation. Verification ledger.
